key_insight: Learning rates or fluxes instead of solution states enables neural time-stepping that preserves key gradient-flow structures.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports physically consistent PDE simulation through mass conservation and conditionally guaranteed energy decay.
method: Use spatial neural networks to approximate Onsager rates for nonconserved dynamics and fluxes for conserved dynamics.
Advance solutions with explicit least-squares, implicit variational, or predictor–corrector schemes.
Guarantee discrete mass conservation under periodic or no-flux boundaries and unconditional energy stability for implicit schemes satisfying a descent criterion.
evidence_signal: Experiments on heat, Allen–Cahn, Cahn–Hilliard, Fokker–Planck, and coupled Poisson–Nernst–Planck equations demonstrate accuracy, robustness, and structure preservation.
watch_item: Implicit energy stability requires satisfying a suitable descent criterion; it is not automatic for arbitrary neural optimization outcomes.
paper_title: Structure-Preserving Neural Time-Stepping for Gradient-Flow PDEs via Onsager's Variational Principle
